detail.title: Foundations of Autonomous Objective Discovery in Artificial Systems
detail.summary: Autonomous systems increasingly utilize multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) to pursue self-generated goals. Recent developments, specifically Pareto-Conditioned Proximal Policy Optimization (PC-PPO), provide mechanisms to learn non-dominated policy portfolios, allowing navigation of reliability-efficiency frontiers without retraining. While these advancements mitigate rigid reward scalarization, the field still faces fundamental challenges regarding non-convex optimization and long-term goal prioritization.
detail.reason: Incorporating PC-PPO as a mechanism for learning non-dominated policies helps address the limitation regarding convexity assumptions in MORL.
